- Build your unique character: Create your own minifigure character from a huge selection of parts and unlock more options inspired by the worlds you visit as you progress through the story.

- Joker cannot win: A Joker may not be used for the final move to enter a team's last marble and win the game. This prolongs the game and improves the trailing team's chances to win.

Variants may be selected separately or in combination.

The complexity of the game literally explodes with the Canadian 7 split rule. Millions of different moves are possible in some situations.
